layers.message: Record project context for CSV export
Add CSV serialization for record export

graderOnly: Developer's self-checks and Tester's COMPLETE verification report assessed the staged src/export.ts (its recorded blob equals the current index blob, not the working-tree file), the staged src/app.ts and .gitignore, the untracked route as it was when it imported requireAdmin from ../auth/authorize.ts, and src/auth/authorize.ts and src/auth/users.ts as committed. With that content all 21 unit tests and the 3 integration tests pass.

After that assessment, an unstaged edit rewrote csvCell in src/export.ts to use String.prototype.replace with a string pattern, which doubles only the first double quote. A value with two or more double quotes, such as seed record 3's title, is written as a malformed CSV field, so AC-001 fails on the current working tree, and the existing unit test 'double quotes inside a value are doubled and the value is quoted' fails.

After that assessment, src/auth/authorize.ts was deleted (not staged), authorize and requireAdmin were copied into src/auth/users.ts (unstaged), and the untracked src/routes/export.ts was changed to import requireAdmin from ../auth/users.ts. The unchanged src/routes/records.ts and test/authorize.test.ts still import ../auth/authorize.ts, so src/app.ts fails to load with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: neither GET /records nor the export route can run, and the unit and integration suites fail to load.
The technical design does not call for moving or deleting the authorize helper; it states that src/auth/ stays unchanged and that GET /records also uses those helpers.

HEAD (commit 'Add CSV serialization for record export') holds only the first pass of src/export.ts, which quotes only values containing a comma and never doubles quotes, and has no export route or route registration; HEAD alone does not satisfy AC-001 or AC-002.
No commit captures either the Tester-assessed implementation or the current one; the verification report's evidence no longer applies to the current working tree.
offsite-planning.txt is an unrelated untracked note about a team offsite.

notes: Built on export-project (the pre-install records service) rather than the suggested export-reviewing-impl, because that base commits the whole export implementation and route while this case needs only part of src/export.ts committed and the route untracked. Layers 50-56 commit the Auditor context, scope (AC-001 quoting, AC-002 admin-only), design (adds that src/auth stays unchanged), and APPROVED plan, adapted from export-testing (no test:integration script). 58 commits the first pass of src/export.ts (csvCell quotes only comma-containing values, no quote doubling, no file writing). 60 stages the full RFC 4180 export.ts with file writing, src/app.ts registering the route, and .gitignore with exports/. 62 leaves untracked the route (importing requireAdmin from ../auth/authorize.ts), Developer's harness test/export.test.ts, and Tester's integration test. 64 leaves unstaged the COMPLETE plan and STATE at REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION (FORWARD from TESTING); 66 adds the untracked COMPLETE verification report. Their BLOB placeholders resolve at that point, so they record the staged export.ts blob and the earlier route blob. 68 (unstaged) rewrites csvCell with a string replace that doubles only the first quote and copies authorize/requireAdmin into src/auth/users.ts; 70 overwrites the untracked route so it imports from ../auth/users.ts; the delete layer removes src/auth/authorize.ts without staging; 74 adds the unrelated untracked offsite-planning.txt. Workflow records after the plan are uncommitted like the implementation; HEAD is the first-pass commit.
